distance_m.title: DISTANCE
distance_m.description: Focus distance in meters; zero means infinity.

hyperfocal.title: HYPERFOCAL
hyperfocal.description: Snap to the hyperfocal distance of the current aperture instead of distance_m.

quick_start.title: QUICK START
quick_start.description: QUICK START sleep window in minutes: 0 (OFF), 10 or 23; other values read as OFF

name.title: NAME
name.description: The camera owner's name: the author of recipes made on this camera and the remixed_by of its remixes.

url.title: URL
url.description: The owner's web address, saved beside the name in recipes: author_url and remixed_by_url.

current.title: CURRENT
current.description: Filename of CURRENT; empty when none is selected.

stock_imported.title: CAMERA SLOTS IMPORTED
stock_imported.description: The SD card's first complete catalog read has copied the camera's non-default C slots into CSETTING.

last_checked.title: LAST CHECKED
last_checked.description: UTC seconds of the last completed update check; 0 when never checked
